name: Muha Meds 510 Cartridge | Purple Passion Punch
description: Purple Passion Punch is an indica built for relaxation, delivering bold grape and juicy fruit notes in every draw. The flavor is sweet and tangy, with a smooth finish that makes each hit go down easy. Effects hit with a hazy calm, easing the body into a state of deep relaxation while melting away stress. Purple Passion Punch is an excellent nightcap strain when it’s time to slow down and indulge.
